answer: Make each new identity pay a refundable bond before sharing rewards. A newcomer locks 12 tokens, receives a random task, signs one answer, and gets checks from three established peers; an auditor replays a sample. Passing returns the bond and builds reputation, while duplicated proofs burn the stake and suspend linked accounts for 10 rounds. A farm of 400 fakes ties up 4,800 tokens and funds 1,200 reviews before earning. Put signed result hashes on a public ledger: a copied route appears twice, like tracks crossing a dune, and a copper seal ties each voyage to one key.
